news.headline: Sources: Raiders TE Brock Bowers expected to play vs. Saints
news.detail: Raiders tight end Brock Bowers is expected to play Sunday against the Saints, barring a surprise, a source told ESPN

news.headline: Questionable (Knee - Meniscus)
news.detail: Bowers underwent a meniscus trim on his left knee on Sept. 8 that sidelined him for the first two games of the season, and he then followed up back-to-back limited sessions to kick off Week 3 prep before sitting out Friday, which head coach Klint Kubiak chalked up as a planned absence, per Sam Warre
